response.why: I have no board presence and they have two untapped fliers (Siren 1/1, Mastermind 2/1); flashing in Floodpits Drowner now to tap+stun the bigger threat (Mastermind) denies 2 damage this combat and keeps it tapped through their next untap too, since Drowner can't block fliers anyway so holding it for a block isn't useful here.
response.plan: Proactively stun their best attacker each turn with Drowner when I have no relevant blocker, then rebuild board with Preacher of the Schism and eventually Sheoldred once I have 4 mana; taking 1 from the unstunned Siren is fine at 19 life.

event_vocabulary: they_cast:<card name | removal | counter | creature | any>

response.why: Only 2 mana untapped and nothing castable at that cost; Floodpits Drowner can't block their flier and would trade unfavorably into their deathtouch Preacher of the Schism (I'd lose it for nothing since 2 power doesn't kill a 4-toughness Preacher), so no blocks and just absorb the damage.
response.plan: Stay patient until I have 4 mana untapped to deploy Sheoldred or Enduring Curiosity as a real answer; keep Drowner alive as a ground blocker against non-deathtouch threats and future attacker.

response.why: I'm down to 13 life and lost my only blocker to Cut Down; 5 lands after this drop lets me either drop two bodies (Preacher of the Schism as a deathtouch wall plus Deep-Cavern Bat to see their hand and strip a removal/counter before I commit Sheoldred) or go straight for the huge Sheoldred payoff, so I want the engine to weigh the 2-for-1 tempo/info play against the single big threat that's more exposed to their remaining Go for the Throats.
response.plan: Stabilize the board against their fliers and Preacher of the Schism while setting up Sheoldred or Enduring Curiosity as a follow-up threat once I've either protected it with information from Deep-Cavern Bat or accepted the removal risk; life total is getting low so I need blockers online soon.

response.why: I'm at 6 life facing their Sheoldred plus two fliers and their own Preacher — a rational opponent won't suicide Sheoldred or their deathtouch Preacher into my deathtouch blockers, so they'll likely attack only with the evasive fliers (Siren+Mastermind for 3); Deep-Cavern Bat can actually block and trade with a flier (something a second ground Preacher cannot do) while also revealing/stripping a card from their hand, versus two Preachers which only threaten trades they can simply decline.
response.plan: Develop maximum defense this turn since I'm critically low on life and facing Sheoldred's draw-step drain; hold Enduring Curiosity for a safer window since it's a weak blocker here (no deathtouch, no flying) and vulnerable to their remaining removal.

response.why: This position is nearly lost either way — I'm at 4-6 life against a snowballing board (Sheoldred draining/gaining life every draw, plus Kaito or more card draw) — but two deathtouch Preachers give me two credible trades against their ground threats (Sheoldred, their Preacher, or Kaito) versus only one with the Bat, even though neither line stops their fliers or the Sheoldred draw-drain engine.
response.plan: This is a near-desperate spot; prioritize deathtouch blockers to trade off their biggest ground threats and hope to draw removal or a way to close the life gap, since Sheoldred's drain makes every future draw step dangerous.
